_help: HOW TO ADD DIALOGUE: append an entry to 'sequences'. Each sequence has an id, a trigger and a list of lines.
cards_left / cards_drawn count the draw pile (deck); cards_drawn counts from when the dealer finishes dealing. A sequence plays once and sequences that trigger together are queued.
A 'manual' sequence never starts by itself; include it from another sequence with a line like { "play_sequence": "shuffle" }.
Line fields: speaker (a DialogueSpeaker speaker_id, or 'player' for internal thoughts), text, and optionally
audio (res:// path to a clip; it plays from the speaker and sets the line length), delay (seconds before the line),
duration (override the line length), pause (seconds after the line). Without audio the length is estimated from the text.
event (runs a table action when the line starts: 'shuffle_deck' or 'deal_hands'); add "wait": true to hold the line until it finishes.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: Well, I guess I start since I'm the dealer.

lines.speaker: left_npc
lines.text: Why did they choose you to be the dealer anyway?

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: Probably because I'm the worst criminal here.

lines.speaker: right_npc
lines.text: Ha. Don't flatter yourself.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: Five cards in hand, no more. Make a set and it goes face up on the table. No arguing.

lines.speaker: left_npc
lines.text: And when the deck runs out?

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: I reshuffle. Once. Same as they told us.

lines.speaker: right_npc
lines.text: They told us the rules a dozen times.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I can't afford to lose. I'm not dying tonight.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I should probably be careful that they're not watching when I peek at their cards.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: Hold on, let me shuffle.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: That's the last of the deck.

lines.speaker: left_npc
lines.text: Already? That went fast.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: Remember, I only reshuffle once. After this, it's over.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Last chance. Whoever has the most sets walks out of here.

lines.speaker: left_npc
lines.text: You ever wonder who's paying for all this? The candles, the wine, a whole room just for us.

lines.speaker: right_npc
lines.text: The state. The same people who put us here.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: Rehabilitation through competition. That's what the paperwork called it.

lines.speaker: left_npc
lines.text: I signed mine without reading it. Didn't think anyone read those.

lines.speaker: right_npc
lines.text: Eyes on your own cards, all of you.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Nobody here is going to play fair. I shouldn't either.
